title: 2026-10-13 v1: two Flash turns, idle ACP switch to gpt-6-astra, then two Astra turns. Measure Flash source response/next-request recurrence, foreign source ciphertext exclusion at Astra, a newly minted first Astra response, and second-destination native replay. Flash summary/content field preservation is checked separately on native hops; cross-boundary plaintext representation and semantic retention are unverified, not inferred from foreign-cipher absence. This is not the active-turn switch test. Offline validation is not a live pass.

steps.prompt: Without tools, find the remainder of 7 to the power 13 modulo 97 by repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply the previous remainder by 19 and reduce modulo 97. Explain briefly.
Without tools, independently work out the remainder of 11 to the power 9 modulo 101 using repeated squaring. Give a short calculation.
Without tools, multiply that last remainder by 23 and reduce modulo 101. Give the result and finish with FLASH-TO-ASTRA-V1-DONE.
